name: Valvetrain & Timing
description: Camshaft (incl. DI pump lobe), VVT phaser, center valve, solenoid, limiter/lockout, timing chain/tensioner/guide, lifters and trays (AFM vs delete), pushrods and rocker arms.

components.name: Camshaft
components.description: Single in-block hydraulic-roller camshaft driven by chain through the VVT phaser. Besides 16 valve lobes it carries the 4-lobe high-pressure fuel pump lobe at the rear that drives the DI pump through a roller follower. Stock LT4 cam: 188°/223° @ .050, .502/.561 in lift (1.8 rockers), 120° LSA; LT1: 200°/207°, .551/.524 in, 116.5° LSA.
components.location: In the block cam tunnel above the crankshaft, centered in the V.

factory.name: GM LT4 camshaft
factory.notes: LT1 cam 12629512. 1-bolt cam gear, 4X cam-sensor target poles. AFM on LT4 except manual-trans ZL1 (per Summit).

raceOptions.name: BTR Gen V Stage 2 LT1/LT4 supercharged ("blower") cam
raceOptions.notes: Listed as .639/.639 in lift, 114 LSA, +38% fuel pump lobe; requires spring upgrade and AFM delete.

raceOptions.name: BTR Gen V 220 cam (NA LT1)
raceOptions.notes: 220/23X, .644/.644 in, 113 LSA, +32% fuel lobe; requires AFM delete, 4° phaser limiter and SK007 springs.

raceOptions.name: COMP / Katech / Crane custom Gen V grind
raceOptions.notes: Specify DI pump lobe lift, VVT or locked phaser, and AFM delete.

installNotes: Lube lobes and journals with cam break-in/assembly lube; install with a cam handle without nicking bearings.
Install retainer plate before the phaser.
Degree the cam (intake centerline) against the cam card with the phaser locked/in its default (park) position.
If cam fuel lobe differs from stock, the ECM fuel-pump calibration must be changed.
inspection: Inspect lobes and roller lifters at rebuild; cut oil filter for metal.

components.name: VVT cam phaser (camshaft position actuator) & sprocket
components.description: Vane-type hydraulic phaser that is also the cam sprocket. Oil routed by the center valve bolt rotates the cam relative to the chain. It parks at a locked default position on start-up.
components.location: Front of the camshaft, behind the front cover.

factory.name: GM Gen V VVT phaser (LT1/LT4 2014-2021 style)
factory.notes: 2022+ LT1/LT4 and 2019+ truck engines use a "Gen V Plus" phaser - limiters are not interchangeable.

raceOptions.name: Lock out with BTR 0° limiter block (keep VVT hardware)
VVT delete: LS2/LS3-style non-VVT cam gear + BTR cam-sensor conversion
raceOptions.notes: BTR warns: if your cam is designed for a locked phaser, do NOT use the VVT-delete gear (phaser has built-in advance when locked).

installNotes: Align phaser timing mark with crank sprocket mark at #1 TDC.
Install limiter block (if used) with the phaser tool kit before fitting.
Torque the center bolt per engine.valvetrain.phaser-center-bolt.
inspection: Check for cam-correlation DTCs/VVT error logs after each event.

components.name: Phaser center bolt / oil control valve
components.description: The bolt that clamps the phaser to the cam is a hollow spool valve (camshaft position actuator valve) directing oil to the advance/retard chambers; it is actuated by the solenoid on the front cover.

factory.name: GM camshaft position actuator valve (center bolt)

hardware.item: Camshaft position actuator valve / cam sprocket bolt
hardware.torqueSequence: 48 ft-lb, then +90°. Hold the cam/crank against rotation - never use the timing chain to hold torque.
hardware.notes: Listed by Summit ("camshaft position actuator solenoid") and Michigan Motorsports ("camshaft sprocket bolt / VVT actuator").

installNotes: Lube threads and under-head, start by hand; torque with the cam locked.

components.name: VVT actuator solenoid (front cover)
components.description: ECM-controlled solenoid on the front cover whose plunger pushes the spool of the phaser center valve. A locked-out race cam still needs the solenoid plugged in or the DTC disabled in the calibration.
components.location: Front of the timing cover, centered over the cam nose.

factory.name: GM Gen V camshaft position actuator solenoid

hardware.notes: Value not found; typical M6 into aluminum cover. Replace O-ring. Checked 2026-10: GM SI fastener table for the C7 LT1 (screenshots reposted on CorvetteForum) lists 'Camshaft Position (CMP) Actuator Magnet Bolts 10 N·m (88 lb in)'. The magnet is the front-cover-mounted VVT solenoid. The central CMP actuator solenoid valve is a separate part: 65 N·m (48 lb ft) +90°, new part.

installNotes: New O-ring lubricated with engine oil; center it on the phaser valve.

components.description: Billet insert that fixes the phaser at 0° (lockout) or restricts travel (e.g. 4°) so a bigger cam keeps piston-to-valve clearance. Popular on road-race LT builds for repeatable cam timing.

raceOptions.name: BTR Gen V 0° phaser lockout block (2014-2021 LT1/LT4)
raceOptions.notes: Requires BTR LT1/L83 tool kit, or LT4-specific tool for LT4.

components.name: Timing chain
components.description: Single-row chain from crank sprocket to cam phaser sprocket. Stock LT uses a hydraulic/spring tensioner and a guide; aftermarket "tensioner-elimination" sets use a true-roller chain with a fixed guide for road-race reliability.
components.location: Front of block behind the front cover.

factory.name: GM Gen V single-row timing chain

raceOptions.name: Cloyes 9-3678X5 tensioner-elimination LT timing set (single-row true roller, adjustable crank gear)

installNotes: Align marks; rotate engine two full turns by hand and re-check marks before installing the front cover.
inspection: Check chain stretch at rebuild (cam-to-crank correlation values in ECM trend upward with stretch).

factory.name: GM Gen V timing chain tensioner

hardware.notes: Summit and Michigan Motorsports both list 18 ft-lb.

components.name: Hydraulic roller lifters (AFM or non-AFM)
components.description: Hydraulic roller lifters (0.842 in body). On AFM engines 8 of them are collapsible deactivation lifters - a common failure point. Road-race builds delete AFM and run LS7-style lifters (GM/Delphi) or premium race lifters with link-bar trays.
components.location: Lifter bores in the block valley, riding on the cam lobes.

factory.name: GM Gen V hydraulic roller lifter (AFM on AFM cylinders)

raceOptions.name: Delphi LS7-style lifters (AFM delete, 16)
raceOptions.notes: Included in Michigan Motorsports and ICT LT AFM delete kits.

raceOptions.name: Johnson / Morel / BTR short-travel race lifters
raceOptions.notes: Better high-rpm control; check oil-feed band position for Gen V.

installNotes: Soak lifters in oil, install in trays, note roller orientation.
AFM delete REQUIRES a non-AFM camshaft profile and the AFM function disabled in the ECM calibration.
inspection: At teardown: check roller for flat spots/needle bearing play.

components.name: Rocker arms (1.8:1) & rocker stands
components.description: Die-cast 1.8:1 roller-fulcrum (trunnion) rockers on pedestal stands, non-adjustable, no offset. The trunnion needle bearings are the weak point at high spring pressure - install a bronze/roller trunnion upgrade or shaft rockers for racing.
components.location: Top of each cylinder head under the valve covers.

factory.name: GM 1.8 ratio die-cast roller-fulcrum rocker, pedestal mount

raceOptions.name: Trunnion upgrade kit for factory rockers
raceOptions.notes: Recommended by BTR with their cam kits.

raceOptions.name: Shaft-mount rocker system for Gen V
raceOptions.notes: Best stability for high spring pressure; check valve-cover clearance. Part numbers not verified here.

hardware.torqueSequence: Bring the lifter to the base circle for each pair before final torque (rotate engine; follow firing order).
hardware.notes: Summit and Michigan Motorsports both list 22 ft-lb.

installNotes: Install pairs with the lifters on base circle; torque to 22 ft-lb.
Check rocker-to-retainer and rocker-to-cover clearance with high-lift cams.
inspection: Check for trunnion play, broken needles in the oil filter.
